title: clematis recta subvar. fruticosa
intro: Clematis recta subvar. fruticosa, commonly known as Clematis recta, is a plant species in the Ranunculaceae family. The plant is known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Clematis recta include alkaloids, glycosides, and other organic compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as treating anxiety, insomnia, and fever, although more research is needed to confirm these effects.
